''See also: [[Forged Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Forging]] is a versatile process used to shape [[madra]], energy, or physical materials into specific objects, tools, or techniques. It can be used to create tangible items such as blades, spears, axes, shields, and armor, or more ephemeral [[constructs]] like ghostly cleavers, stars of [[pure madra]], and illusory arrows. These creations can range from simple [[scales]] and coins to massive, complex structures like diamond [[chains]] or [[giant]] hands. As a [[technique]], [[Forging]] allows practitioners to manifest specialized abilities, such as the [[Titan’s Blade|Titan's Blade]] which expands a weapon's size, or the [[Netherclaw]] which forms a massive beast claw from [[madra]]. The quality and stability of Forged objects depend on the user's skill, the density of the [[madra]] used, and the time taken to create them; rushed [[Forging]] often results in unstable or short-lived [[constructs]]. Advanced [[Soulsmithing]] involves using specialized tools like hammers to inject a creator's [[willpower]] and [[Authority|authority]] into an object, often requiring high-tier locations like the [[Soulforge]] to achieve superior results. [[Forging]] can also be applied to complex biological or spiritual [[constructs]], such as Bloodforged [[Iron]] bodies or puppet [[constructs]] assembled from remnants.}}
